ambiguities: That index 0, 1, 2 mean the documented buckets in that order is observed, not documented: it held in three settlements.
The top bucket has never been observed paying.
The official example is a 15-minute series; only the 1-day series has been seen live.

evidence.claim: Three buckets with the stated endpoint ownership, exactly one paying
evidence.label: V

evidence.claim: Index order is a rule rather than a pattern
evidence.label: U

observation: One instant, the expiry: linear interpolation between the HyperCore mark price updates immediately before and after it. Not a TWAP, not a candle close, not the oracle price.

quotes: There are three price buckets depending on the target price at the time of settlement: `< P1`, `[P1, P2)` and `≥ P2.`
Exactly one of the 3 outcomes settles to 1, and the others settle to 0.
The target price computation uses the same interpolation as binary markets described above.
sources.title: Hyperliquid docs: Contract specifications, Recurring outcomes

quotes: Settlement automatically converts either Yes to `settleFraction` quote tokens and No to `1 - settleFraction` quote tokens.
sources.title: Hyperliquid docs: HIP-4 Outcome markets, Mechanics
